title: Balancing is localization of the ordinary comparison
statement: After composition with completedTensorModel on its completed scalar side, scalarCompletion is precisely mapDerivedCategorySquareIso of scalarCompletionOrdinary, for every finite l-adic coefficient extension and scheme W.

proof.text: Localize the ordinary balancing square of exact functors, then compose with the inverse exact model to obtain a candidate comparison. The localization composition and natural transformation factor equations give the complex-counit normalization of this candidate, using completedTensorModel_counit and cancellation of the inverse model. The uniqueness clause of scalarCompletion_existsUnique identifies it with scalarCompletion. Cancel the inverse model to obtain the asserted isomorphism equality.
